responsibility: Declares the public bootstrap interface for GNU Modula-2's SYSTEM module support in the mc runtime scaffold. This generated header publishes machine-property constants such as bits per byte and bytes per word plus the C-callable helpers used to implement ISO SYSTEM set-valued SHIFT and ROTATE operations on multiword sets, including left/right variants and the generic signed-count entry points that generated code or backend support can call when these operations cannot be inlined.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the same-stem GSYSTEM.c file, which is only a dummy module body providing empty _M2_SYSTEM_init/_M2_SYSTEM_fini link symbols, this header is the actual public interface: it defines SYSTEM constants and declares the SHIFT/ROTATE helper entry points used by generated code.
